meta_description: Trademark Improvements is a trusted painter and decorator in Southampton. Interior and exterior work, quality finishes, free quotes. Call 07836 314113 today.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that transforms your Southampton home. From feature walls to full room makeovers, we deliver lasting quality.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decoration Services in Southampton
services_subhead: We handle everything from small touch-ups to full interior and exterior transformations, with attention to detail on every job.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Wall and ceiling painting, feature walls, and full room redecorations. We prep thoroughly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless on completion.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof coatings for fascias, soffits, doors, and rendered walls. We work in all seasons and protect your home from the elements for years to come.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional hanging of wallpaper, textured finishes, and decorative wall treatments. Pattern matching and crisp edges on every installation.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, dado rails, doors, and window frames painted to a professional finish. We sand, prime, and paint for a flawless look.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Polished plaster, Venetian effects, metallic finishes, and bespoke colour matching. Create the look you want with our skilled decorative techniques.

services.title: Commercial Decoration
services.desc: Offices, shops, and rental properties decorated on schedule and within budget. We work around your business hours to minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: We treat every wall in your home like it's our own.
about_para_1: Trademark Improvements was founded on a simple belief: that great decoration shouldn't break the bank. For over 15 years, we've worked across Southampton and the surrounding areas, building a reputation for honest pricing, reliable service, and finishes that last. We're fully insured, use quality materials, and take pride in leaving every home better than we found it.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen to what you want, turn up when we say we will, and take care of the details that others miss. Whether it's a single room refresh or a complete exterior overhaul, we approach every job with the same level of care and professionalism. References and photos of our work are available on request.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Excellent work. Mark came round, gave us a fair quote, and got the job done in three days. The whole interior of our lounge looks brand new. No fuss, no mess, and he cleaned up properly after himself. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Needed our hallway and stairs redecorated before the in-laws visited. Mark fitted us in at short notice, matched the existing paint perfectly, and the finish is superb. Much cheaper than the big chains too. Can't fault it.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Had our exterior fascias and soffits painted. Professional job, turned up on time, and weatherproofed everything properly. Looks like new. Very happy with the result and the price.
reviews.author: Robert C.
